title: Evaluating Search Systems through Field Codes and Classifications: The Case of the First Published Swedish Nursing Study
reasoning: The paper evaluates and compares established search systems and approaches for identifying nursing-related documents. It does not have a component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as its primary focus. While nursing research can involve ethical topics, the study itself is a methodological comparison of search systems, not an evaluation of faith or ethics.
